name: Jan Waterman
message: I have a question that has been bothering me for a long time. Here you are, a profitable cigarette company, selling many packages of cigarettes a day. I was curious about how you can live with a clear conscience when you know that every package of cigarettes that is sold could ruin one person's life. It seems to me that it would be very hard to live with oneself if you knew this overpowering fact. I once heard a man say something that to me is very appropriate here. He said "Every person that smokes will eventually die of lung cancer if something else doesn't get him first." I think that with this in mind it would be very hard to publish ads which are not actually the truth. For instance, you show a younger man and woman golfing and then sitting down to smoke. I know very well that this cute girl you show does not look like that in real life if she smokes, especially not with all the tar and nicotine you put in cigarettes. I would appreciate an answer concerning my question. Thank you very much.
